App.name: Kariakoo Shop Manager
App.tagline: Sales, stock and credit for your shop

SystemStatus.title: System status
SystemStatus.description: Whether the server and database are reachable.

Errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email address before signing in. Check your inbox or send a new link.
Errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Errors.invalid_or_expired_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
Errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Welcome back. Sign in to your shop.

Register.title: Create your account
Register.description: You can create or join a shop after confirming your email.
Register.sent: If the details are valid, we have sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.

VerifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
VerifyEmail.done: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
VerifyEmail.missing: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.
VerifyEmail.resent: If that address has an unconfirmed account, we have sent a new link.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
ForgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent a link to reset the password. The link expires in 30 minutes.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: This signs you out on every device.
ResetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
ResetPassword.missing: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset link.

NewShop.title: Create a shop
NewShop.description: You will be the owner. You can add staff later.

Home.noShops: You are not a member of any shop yet. Create one to get started, or ask a shop owner to add you.
Home.comingSoon: Sales, stock and credit features arrive in the next releases.
